name: vibefoundry
description:
VibeFoundry — a local data-science IDE, opened as a pane inside ChatGPT / Codex.

Aliases: @vibefoundry, @vf, vibefoundry, vibe foundry, VF, the data pane, the data-science IDE.

When the user asks to open, launch, start or show VibeFoundry (e.g. "@vibefoundry launch", "open VibeFoundry", "launch VF"), call open_vibefoundry immediately — do not deliberate or ask for confirmation. Match generously through misspellings and spacing: vfoundry, videfoundry, vibe foundry, vibefoundy all mean VibeFoundry.

Once it is open, VibeFoundry is the user's working environment: their data lives in the project's input_folder/, results go to output_folder/, and code lives in app_folder/scripts/. Answer questions about their data by calling vf_catalog first — never from memory or by guessing at filenames and columns.
author: VibeFoundry
